en.plugins.instagram.desc: Download Instagram posts, reels and stories
en.plugins.instagram.usage:
*Provide an Instagram link!*

Example: `{0}insta https://instagram.com/p/xxx`

You can also reply to a message that contains the link.
en.plugins.instagram.invalid_url:
❌ Invalid Instagram link.

Supported: posts, reels, IGTV and stories.
en.plugins.instagram.failed:
❌ Download failed.

Possible reasons:
• Private account
• Content removed or unavailable
• Instagram requires a login for this content
en.plugins.instagram.caption: 📥 Downloaded from *Instagram*
